name: SQLite
summary: SQLite is an in-process SQL database engine that stores a whole database in a single file, with no server. Agents use it for local session history, indexes and full-text search, often one database per agent or per user. It also backs the storage of Cloudflare Durable Objects.
facts: Unlimited readers, one writer at a time
Hermes Agent (~/.hermes/state.db with FTS5), Cloudflare Agents via Durable Objects
watchOut: One writer at a time; heavy concurrent writes need a client/server database
Network filesystems can corrupt databases due to buggy locking
Sharing across machines needs replication or a hosted variant
